name: Funding Activity
blurb: Capital flowing into AI, by stage and sector.

reading.body:
The dataset records 122 funding filings across 47 companies, captured daily through August 2026, with the count rising from 119 to 122 over the final two weeks of the period.

The growth is incremental rather than dramatic. The series moved up by three filings across roughly two weeks, with a brief dip to 118 on August 19 and 20 before recovering. That pattern suggests normal administrative lag in filing records rather than a sudden surge or contraction in deal activity. The ratio of 122 filings to 47 companies indicates that several companies account for more than one filing each, which could reflect staged tranches, debt alongside equity, or follow-on rounds, but the data does not specify which.

What the data does not cover is consequential. There are no figures for deal size, so the 122 filings could represent a narrow band of small rounds or a concentration of very large ones. Stage and sector breakdowns are listed as absent. Without dollar amounts, it is not possible to connect this filing activity to the scale of capital required to fund compute infrastructure or power capacity, which are the upstream constraints that determine how much AI development the funding can actually support.
